microscopic_hypothesis: Quantized cubic links coupled to three real charged molecular plaquettes per cell. Each plaquette is a distinct four-site spinful Hubbard ring with two fermions and compensating ionic charge. Ring sites on different molecules are distinct; electromagnetic links are shared.
microscopic_H: H = sum_links E_l^2/(2 epsilon_b) + sum_plaquettes [sum_edges,spin (-t exp(i e theta_edge)c^dagger_next,spin c_edge,spin+h.c.) + U sum_sites n_up n_down]. There is NO bare B^2 or cosine magnetic plaquette term.
microscopic_scope: Exact isolated matter ring and exact source derivatives. Full compact link plus ring many-body ground, nonlinear quantum corrections and microscopic Gauss projection are NOT solved by this calculation.

source_conventions.gauge: The chosen Peierls sign determines charge/gauge transformation conventions. Replacing e by -e reverses rho and J but not Pi. Electron peer's charge sign must be reconciled explicitly, not by a mass normalization.
source_conventions.frequency: z=omega+i eta, eta>0; retarded Fourier e^{-i omega t}
source_conventions.momentum: q in [-pi,pi]^3, link midpoint convention; qhat_i=2 sin(q_i/2)

exact_ring_response.ground: Unique 28-dimensional two-fermion sector ground; all other 27 eigenstates retained, including triplets, particle-hole configurations and double occupancy.
exact_ring_response.edge_Pi: K_edge(z)=diag(<C_l>)+chi_JJ(z). Both frequency poles and native contact remain; no static-only Ward envelope and no manually subtracted K(0).
exact_ring_response.virtual_pairs: These are actual intraring particle-hole and double-occupancy quantum states. This is not a hidden relativistic Dirac electron/positron sea; that target remains open.

finite_q_embedding.R: R_0i=exp(-i q_j/2), R_1j=exp(i q_i/2), R_2i=-exp(i q_j/2), R_3j=-exp(-i q_i/2), all others zero
finite_q_embedding.density_phase: Plaquette site coordinates (-1/2,-1/2),(1/2,-1/2),(1/2,1/2),(-1/2,1/2) in axes i,j; density source phases exp(i q.x_s)
finite_q_embedding.D: D(q,z)=[Pi(q,z)-epsilon_b z^2 I_3]^{-1}; D_T=F^dagger D F with F orthonormal and F^dagger qhat=0. Project AFTER full inversion.
finite_q_embedding.four_current: density_current_response returns chi(rho,Jx,Jy,Jz), spatial contact and spectral continuity residual. chi has no density contact; Pi=contact+chi_JJ.
finite_q_embedding.induced_static: C4 ring symmetry plus exact pure-gauge cancellation leaves K_edge(0)=kappa ones(4,4). Thus Pi(q,0)=kappa(|qhat|^2 I-qhat qhat^T), kappa=0.23351859895900084 from exact interacting ring, not inserted Maxwell term.

actual_finite_collective_realization.status: A defined finite quadratic quantized Hamiltonian with exact correlated-ring transition energies/residues. Its normal modes and finite-time feedback are solved exactly. Interpreting it as the complete nonlinear Hubbard/link model is an amplitude-linear-response closure, NOT a proven controlled approximation at epsilon_b=1.
actual_finite_collective_realization.coordinates: Mass-normalized field Q_A=sqrt(epsilon_b) A and transition coordinates x_n; every current-active pole of every ring orientation retained. A complex q realization abbreviates the equivalent real +/-q pair.
actual_finite_collective_realization.H: H_collective=(P^dagger P+Q^dagger M Q)/2; M=[[C(q)/epsilon_b,-b/sqrt(epsilon_b)],[-b^dagger/sqrt(epsilon_b),diag(Delta_n^2)]], b_n=sqrt(2 Delta_n) conjugate(v_nJ R). Eliminating x gives exactly the retarded D inverse above.
actual_finite_collective_realization.feedback: Field motion drives pair coordinates; pair coordinates drive the field back. This is not an externally prescribed free sea or an inert susceptibility endpoint.
actual_finite_collective_realization.spectral: D=sum_modes u_A u_A^dagger/(lambda_mode-z^2), with u_A=field eigenvector/sqrt(epsilon_b). Positive nonzero eigenvalues carry positive weights; sum of three field residues=3/epsilon_b. Zero longitudinal gauge mode is not a third photon.
actual_finite_collective_realization.linearized_Gauss: n=(sqrt(epsilon_b) qhat, diag(Delta^-2)b^dagger qhat) obeys M n=0. G=n^dagger P is conserved. Physical quadratic sector is G=0 modulo Q->Q+n lambda. Transverse field observables remove the zero gauge orbit. This is distinct from proving the full compact microscopic Gauss-ground projection.
actual_finite_collective_realization.causality: Finite Hermitian stable collective realization supplies upper-half-plane analytic retarded D with full matter/field poles; finite-frequency tensors are evaluated, not replaced by a two-pole ultraviolet Maxwell model. No infinite-volume relativistic light-cone theorem is claimed.

comparators.frozen: Drop chi_JJ while retaining contact. This wrong fixed/no-feedback model generates a q=0 mass and nearly 1.933 frequencies instead of soft photon branches.
comparators.free: Set Hubbard repulsion U=0 with the same ring geometry, source and electric inertia. Its poles differ from interacting U=4; free sea cannot be relabelled as the correlated candidate.
comparators.decoupled: Set microscopic link_charge=0 in H(theta), leaving matter and primitive electric inertia intact. J and contact both vanish; execute the same polarization/collective_matrix APIs. Pi=0 and three zero field restoring eigenvalues result. No magnetic dispersion survives.

join: One literal compatible next law is shared quantized links plus these same Hubbard rings plus the peer's charged Peierls hopping on those links. This is explicitly a NEW combined law. Recompute joint ground, G, D, J and contact; standalone peer cavity restoration must be removed rather than superposed. Alternative: construct mobile odd-charge N=1/3 defects and inter-ring motion directly in this ring law. No such charged source or recoil mass is fabricated here.
